summary: Pin sits at a works compound and path by the busway bridge; no van access.
reasons: Only reached from the bridge deck or paths
Works compound and site sheds on the spot
No tyre tracks to a usable stop

drivers.seclusion: Treed park and cemetery around it, no homes, but the spot is a compound and footpath apron at the bridge edge.
drivers.access_and_room: The only sealed approach is the bridge deck, a busway; the rest is footpath and bush. Esri shows site sheds on the apron, QLD shows a fenced works site.
drivers.traffic: Bridge traffic directly beside the pin.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles or camping seen; the nearest car park is 79 m away outside the pin area.

flags: Low-lying: about 6.5-8.8 m, Brisbane River 265 m away
Steep: max grade 15.4% at the bank beside the pin
Active works compound in the QLD image, now site sheds in Esri
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the bush side; the apron is open to the sky.
cannot_judge: Whether the busway bridge is open to private vehicles
